definitions.explanation: The quality of being based on personal feelings, opinions, or interpretations rather than on objective facts.

examples.japanese: {主観性|しゅかんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{排除|はいじょ}→排除：07631_haijo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{主観性|しゅかんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つきものだ。
examples.english: Subjectivity is inherent in the evaluation of art.

examples.japanese: ⟦{科学的|かがくてき}→科学的：05677_kagakuteki⟧な⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{主観性|しゅかんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{排|はい}し、⟦{客観的|きゃっかんてき}→客観的：05696_kyakkanteki⟧な⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいて→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: In scientific research, it is required to exclude subjectivity and draw conclusions based on objective data.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{主観|しゅかん}→主観：11466_shukan⟧ (subjectivity, subjective viewpoint) and ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (nature, quality). Used in academic, philosophical, and professional contexts to discuss the inherent bias or personal perspective involved in judgments and evaluations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {主観性|しゅかんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{排除|はいじょ}→排除：07631_haijo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to eliminate subjectivity
- {主観性|しゅかんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: subjectivity enters in
- {主観性|しゅかんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: the problem of subjectivity
- {主観性|しゅかんせい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{客観性|きゃっかんせい}→客観性：17158_kyakkansei⟧: subjectivity and objectivity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{主観|しゅかん}→主観：11466_shukan⟧: subjective viewpoint — the viewpoint itself, rather than the quality of being subjective
- ⟦{客観性|きゃっかんせい}→客観性：17158_kyakkansei⟧: objectivity — the opposite concept; being based on facts rather than feelings
- ⟦{偏見|へんけん}→偏見：06025_henken⟧: prejudice, bias — personal bias based on preconceptions, stronger negative connotation
